# Carousel { #anylumino.astryx.Carousel }

```python
Carousel(
    children=None,
    *,
    gap=1,
    buttons=None,
    edge_fade=None,
    snap=None,
    padding=None,
    **props,
)
```

Scroll child widgets horizontally in an Astryx carousel.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                 | Description                                                             | Default    |
|-----------|----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| children  | ChildInput           | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets. | `None`     |
| gap       | int \| float         | Astryx spacing step between children.                                   | `1`        |
| buttons   | bool \| None         | Whether to show the previous and next controls.                         | `None`     |
| edge_fade | bool \| None         | Whether to fade content at the scroll edges.                            | `None`     |
| snap      | bool \| None         | Whether scrolling snaps to each child.                                  | `None`     |
| padding   | int \| float \| None | Inner padding using the Astryx spacing scale.                           | `None`     |
| **props   | Any                  | JSON-safe Carousel props forwarded to Astryx.                           | `{}`       |
| See       |                      |                                                                         | _required_ |
